# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `questrade` MCP server pointing at Questrade's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.questrade.com/v1/brokerage/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Questrade user login — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Listed in Cursor (`3.13.0`) and Grok Bot (`0.49.0`).
- Logo: Questrade's official mark, from the logo URL Questrade submitted, on a 192×192 tile.
